profile_text.body:
The Distributed AI Research Institute is a nonprofit founded in 2021 and headquartered in Oakland, California. It describes itself as a globally distributed organization of academics, activists, and engineers conducting community-rooted research, and as an independent organization. In its own account, people want and deserve to see themselves reflected in technology, and the suite of tools known as artificial intelligence can include thoughtful, supportive, and inclusive technologies that benefit communities. The institute also states that AI is seldom the solution and that its advance should not be treated as inevitable. It says it provides guidelines and frameworks to researchers and practitioners seeking to build and deploy AI systems without theft and exploitation.

The institute presents itself as a research organization rather than a vendor of AI products, and no AI products are tracked for it. Its site highlights reflections from Kat, Nyalleng, and Raesetje on Deep Learning Indaba 2026, described as an annual gathering in Lagos focused on building Africa's AI future.

Among the facts held about the institute, no lawsuits are listed. Its law exposure is recorded in California, with a count of 237.
